records.rationale: The pinned release executable embeds Aegis stealth-startup, virtualization, instruction filtering, and block-list protection. The installed Steam build exposes no supported anti-tamper-disabled launch item. Native DLL injection would cross that protection boundary, so no bypass or depth discovery was attempted.

records.rationale: The pinned D3D11.1 depth/profile path is technically viable, but the committed production evidence contains only 8 depth rows and does not attest player-pose rows. It therefore does not meet issue #609's 60-second, zero-realign, camera-plus-player completion contract.

records.rationale: The observed build has pinned unique depth, per-frame projection, two-chain metric scale, camera and player poses, a 30 fps audio catalog, a contiguous 60-second run, a five-minute stability run, zero-realign local clip planning, and local delivery validation.
